verdict.rationale: The API docs confirm the transcript and detected languages come back as JSON, so output is structured rather than a plain text blob. Nothing in the pack documents segment- or utterance-level structure or confidence values. A community user asking whether per-word confidence is possible hints it is not readily exposed, but that is a question, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented segment/utterance arrays in the response, confidence scores (per-segment or per-word), independent hands-on corroboration of the structured output.
